title: Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A classic Algerian dish made with tender lamb and aromatic spices, slow-cooked in a flavorful tagine.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and pepper.
Heat the tagine over medium heat and add the lamb shoulder.
Sear the lamb for 2-3 minutes on each side, then remove it from the tagine.
Add the sliced onions to the tagine and cook until they're softened and lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the green olives, Algerian spices, and browned onions back into the tagine.
Return the lamb shoulder to the tagine, cover it, and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb and vegetables for 2-3 hours, or until the lamb is tender and falls apart easily.
Serve the lamb and tagine over couscous or rice.
Garnish with fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro.
